title: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance: policy alert improvements
summary: The briefing's rollout details, default state, licensing and existing alert controls are supported. Minor corrections remain: classify the automatically arriving change as preparation rather than an optional review, and reconcile the checklist with the controls table.

claims.where: front matter: action; summary
claims.claim: The review action rating treats this automatically arriving change as an optional capability.
claims.quote: action: "review"; "MC920304 says the new feature is available by default"; "Tell reviewers that alert email frequency and recipients may change"
claims.fix: Set action to prepare: this is an automatically arriving change with low risk and cost that needs reviewer communication, not a feature that remains unavailable until an administrator chooses it. The summary can retain the advice to review it once it reaches the tenant.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout and At rollout; controls
claims.claim: The governance checklist asks readers to review role-group membership and set new per-policy alert settings that have no corresponding controls-table rows.
claims.quote: "Confirm who is in the Communication Compliance and Communication Compliance Admins role groups"; "Set frequency and recipients per policy"; the table contains only existing alert triggers and a tenant-wide switch gap.
claims.fix: Without adding rows, remove the Before rollout bullet beginning 'Confirm who is in' and the At rollout bullet beginning 'Set frequency and recipients per policy'. Retain the verified role information in Scope and the existing pilot-review advice.
